name: audit
description: Fan an audit target across independent investigation lanes, adversarially verify the findings, then synthesize one report
argsHint: What to audit, e.g. "error handling under lib/" or "auth checks in app/api"

tasks.title: Correctness lane: {{args}}
tasks.detail: Audit {{args}} for correctness bugs: broken edge cases, race conditions, wrong error handling, state that can go stale. Read-only — do not edit files. Publish every defect you find with coord_publish_finding (kind: finding), one finding per defect, with file:line references and a concrete failure scenario. Finish by completing this task with a one-paragraph summary.

tasks.title: Consistency lane: {{args}}
tasks.detail: Audit {{args}} for consistency problems: duplicated logic that has drifted, naming that contradicts behavior, patterns that diverge from how the surrounding codebase does the same thing. Read-only — do not edit files. Publish each issue with coord_publish_finding (kind: finding) with file:line references. Finish by completing this task with a one-paragraph summary.

tasks.title: Resilience lane: {{args}}
tasks.detail: Audit {{args}} for resilience gaps: missing timeouts, unbounded growth, unhandled rejections, failure modes that strand state. Read-only — do not edit files. Publish each gap with coord_publish_finding (kind: finding) with file:line references and what breaks when it triggers. Finish by completing this task with a one-paragraph summary.

tasks.title: Adversarially verify the findings
tasks.detail: Read every finding published in this run (coord_status events). For each, try to REFUTE it against the actual code: reproduce the reasoning, check the cited lines, and decide confirmed or refuted. Publish one coord_publish_finding (kind: learning) per verdict, prefixed CONFIRMED: or REFUTED: with your reasoning. Read-only — do not edit files.

tasks.title: Synthesize the audit report
tasks.detail: Collect the confirmed findings (skip anything the verify phase refuted) and write one ranked report: most severe first, each with file:line, why it matters, and a suggested fix direction. Complete this task with the full report in the completion detail so the lead can finalize the run with it.
